description: Prepublish checks a YouTube script before it is recorded. Paste a finished draft to get hook, structure and pacing scores, a relative attention-risk map across the draft, and the passages most likely to need revision, with a copy-paste rewrite for the top flagged passage shown inline. It can also score just an opening hook, check a script for reused or templated content signals, pre-flight it against YouTube's published advertiser and monetisation policy categories, and convert between word count and spoken runtime. It reads text only: it does not measure or predict the retention of a published video.
